system.description: When you hit with an equipped melee weapon or deal damage with an offensive spell, deal bonus damage equal to (SL x the positive emotions of one bond you possess); all the attack's damage becomes light and its type cannot be changed. That bond cannot be used again for this skill this scene, even on a miss.
